newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE'S OTE TELECOM TO INTRODUCE ISDN SERVICES.
newsitem.headline: GREECE'S OTE TELECOM TO INTRODUCE ISDN SERVICES.

text.p: Greece's OTE telecom will gradually introduce ISDN services in its digital networks with the objective to eventually expand them to the entire country, its board of directors decided on Thursday.
"The introduction of ISDN services will qualitatively upgrade OTE's network and a variety of value-added services will be added," OTE said.

The ISDN system was already launched under a pilot programme in 14 digitised centres and based on a feasibility study there will be strong demand by clients all over Greece, estimated at around 230,000 by the year 2000, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
